name: command-code

cmd: Read the file {taskFile} and follow its instructions exactly.
spawn.$comment-session: No `--no-session` since 0.35.2: with it Command Code kept only checkpoints, so an attempt whose stream lost its final `result` line had no usage anywhere. Without it every attempt leaves ~/.commandcode/projects/<cwd-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl, which src/lib/transcripts/command-code.js prices. Proven 2026-09-21 against command-code 1.54.2 with a real one-line run of this argv: the session file appeared and the reader, looking it up by the stream's sessionId, returned the same token classes the stream's `result` line reported (42778 in total). tests/watch.test.js pins the argv.
spawn.$comment-maxTurns: `--max-turns 10000` because command-code's print mode stops after 100 model round trips by default, mid-task, and exits 8 (result subtype `max_turns`). It rejects 0 and has no unlimited value, so a high number stands in for the no-cap behaviour every other connector has; at the observed pace (100 turns in 17.7 minutes) 10000 is about 30 hours of work. Seen on run wf-mu0vsli9-35807d, attempt ui-1, 2026-09-14: exactly 100 turns, no Stop hook, output ended on 'Now the type check.', retried from scratch on another pool. Run wf-mtttcpvg-3a56d8 attempt summary-1 on 2026-09-09 ended the same way after 210 tool calls. Verified against command-code 1.53.0: `--max-turns 1` exits 8 with subtype max_turns.

$comment-quotaSignatures: empty on purpose: no cmd-specific usage-limit wording has been observed yet; DEFAULT_QUOTA_SIGNATURES in src/lib/quota.js covers the generic provider phrasings.

eventStream.$comment-usage: verified 2026-09-20 against command-code 1.54.2 and tests/fixtures/streams/command-code-hello.jsonl, a real capture of `command-code -p --no-session --tools-all --output-format json 'Reply with the single word ok.'`: the final line is the CLI's own summary (`type: "result"`) carrying `sessionId` and `usage{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens}`; the same totals also ride the nested `model_request_end`, `turn_end` and `run_end` events. inputTokens is inclusive — the durable store's rows agree (inputTokens 16801 beside cacheWriteTokens 16798 in tests/fixtures/transcripts/command-code-session.jsonl) — so standardRead is input - cacheRead - cacheWrite, exactly how src/lib/transcripts/command-code.js derives it. The stream reports no cost at all. The supplied read-only test home contained 0 stream-*.jsonl files on 2026-09-20, so this capture is the first real evidence for the live shape; historical --no-session attempts still have no transcript and stay unknown.
eventStream.$comment-toolKinds: command-code 1.54.2 tool names (its own tool-name registry; `event.toolName`). todo_write, web_fetch, the task_* and monitor_* tools count as other.

$comment-reasoning: verified 2026-09-09 against command-code 1.44.0: `--effort bogus` fails with `Unknown effort "bogus". Supported: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.`; `--effort max --model gpt-5.6-luna` printed `Reasoning effort set to max for GPT-5.6 Luna.` and the JSON model_request_end event carried effort "max". The help text still says `(e.g. low, medium, high) — depends on the model`.

modelProfiles.$comment-deepseek: Facts only, no recommendation: tier and rank are exactly what the generic flash catch-all below would give, kept here so the entry carries the model's own pricing. OpenRouter publishes no indices for this model yet; raise nothing here without benchmark evidence. Pricing is the off-peak rate (17 h/day); peak is $0.30 input / $1.20 output during 01–04 and 06–10 UTC Monday–Friday.

$comment-timeout: No implicit wall-clock timeout; callers may opt in with --timeout or workflow step.timeoutSec
